    | text      = Your value as a sellout is completely contingent on how well you can sell out without alienating
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:30.519
    | text      = the audience that you're supposed to bring with you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:33.360
    | text      = Alex is a valueless commodity on this front.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:36.039
    | text      = He could sell out to the man tomorrow and the man would see no benefit from it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:41.280
    | text      = It's a tough position for him to be in, but Alex needs to recognize that as he exists
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:45.679
    | text      = now, no one has any use for him.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:48.480
    | text      = Trump doesn't care about his support and Alex could completely turn on him and Alex probably
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:52.719
    | text      = wouldn't even get to have a fun nickname like Trump wouldn't even insult him out of
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:56.679
    | text      = it probably.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:02:57.880
    | text      = At the same time, all of Alex's imaginary enemies don't really care that much about
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:03:02.079
    | text      = what he's doing either because there's a hundred more younger, more extreme Alex's out there
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:03:08.400
    | text      = in the world.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:03:09.599
    | text      = If anyone's going to get a sellout offer, it's someone who could actually make a dent
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:03:12.960
    | text      = and drive some followers in the desired direction and Alex isn't that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:03:17.880
    | text      = I've come up with a three-pronged plan to get Alex his groove back and I think if he
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:03:22.440
    | text      = does these things, he could have a shot.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:03:25.559
    | text      = One, stop talking to Roger Stone and ban anyone who's a Trump partisan from the show.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:03:31.920
    | text      = It's fine to have people around who want to have positive feelings towards Trump, but
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:03:35.579
    | text      = Alex needs to cut it out with buddying up to political hacks.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:03:39.440

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = that image needs to stop now.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:03:52.360
    | text      = Larry Nichols, Steve Paczentk.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
